answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the zenith of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The lotus is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the prism. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
